description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for encapsulating search filter parameters specific to vacancy searches within the Recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties such as job title ID, employee number, status, name, publication status, and vacancy IDs, along with their respective getters and setters. It also specifies allowed sort fields and initializes the default sort field in the constructor.

classes.name: VacancySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for passing vacancy search filter parameters, including job title, employee number, status, name, publication state, and vacancy IDs.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Returns whether the vacancy is published.

methods.name: getVacancyIds
methods.description: Returns the list of vacancy IDs filter.

methods.name: setVacancyIds
methods.description: Sets the list of vacancy IDs filter.
